card.title: Kraków Christmas Market on the Main Square
card.description: Annual Christmas market with craft and food stalls on Rynek Główny. The organiser has not confirmed the 2026 dates yet.

card.title: Wiener Christkindlmarkt am Rathausplatz
card.description: Christmas market in front of Vienna City Hall, open daily 10:00–22:00 (24 December until 18:30).

card.title: Morskie Oko
card.description: The largest lake in the Tatra National Park, reached on foot from Palenica Białczańska. A park entry ticket is required.
card.priceNote: Park entry: 11 PLN normal, 5.50 PLN reduced

card.title: The Collector: Ignacy Korwin-Milewski (1846–1926)
card.description: A reconstruction of the painting collection Count Korwin-Milewski assembled between 1880 and 1910 and that was dispersed after his death.
card.creator: Renata Higersberger (curator)

card.title: Perfect Days
card.description: Wim Wenders' quiet Tokyo film about a toilet cleaner and his daily rituals. Premiered at Cannes in May 2023.
card.creator: Wim Wenders

card.title: Muzeum Neonów
card.description: A collection of rescued Polish Cold War-era neon signs, now on the 4th floor of the Palace of Culture and Science. Open daily from 11:00.

card.title: POLIN Museum of the History of Polish Jews
card.description: Museum on the site of the former Warsaw Ghetto, telling a thousand years of Jewish life in Poland. The core exhibition opened in October 2014.

card.title: Jarmark Bożonarodzeniowy we Wrocławiu
card.description: Wrocław's Christmas market across the Market Square, with free entry. Opens at 17:00 on 20 November.

card.title: Christoph König & Timothy Ridout
card.description: Warsaw Philharmonic: world premiere of Pstrokońska-Nawratil's Polaris, Bacewicz's Viola Concerto and Beethoven's Fifth. Starts 19:30.
card.creator: Warsaw Philharmonic, cond. Christoph König

coverQuery: Museum of Modern Art Warsaw Marszałkowska

card.title: Rzeźba po stabilności
card.description: Group show of contemporary sculpture treating sculpture as a shifting system of forces and materials. Curated by Jagna Lewandowska and Szymon Maliborski.

card.title: Łazienki Królewskie
card.description: Royal park and palace complex in central Warsaw. The gardens are open daily 6:00–21:00 and free to enter.

card.title: Ogród Botaniczny PAN w Powsinie
card.description: The Polish Academy of Sciences botanical garden on Warsaw's southern edge. Magnolias in spring, colours in autumn.
